proposed.explanation: The three waves of Filipino identity architecture: (1) FIRST WAVE (Modernist/Brutalist, 1950s–1970s): Key figures = Leandro Locsin, Cesar Concio, Gabriel Formoso, Felipe Mendoza. Landmark buildings = CCP Complex (Tanghalang Pambansa), PICC, UP Holy Sacrifice Church. (2) SECOND WAVE (Neo-Vernacular, 1970s–2000s): Key figure = Francisco Mañosa. Buildings = Coconut Palace, San Miguel HQ, EDSA Shrine, Amanpulo Resort. (3) THIRD WAVE (Contemporary Tropical, 2000s–present): Key firms = BUDJI+ROYAL, WTA Architecture.
